08/08.05.2025 I.A. (Cr.)No. 4773 of 2025 Heard Mr. K.S. Nanda, the learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Manoj Kr. Mishra, the learned A.P.P. for the State.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences under section 376 (DA) of the Indian Penal Code and under section 6 of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo RI for 20 years along with a fine of Rs.20,000/- for the offence under section 6 of the POCSO Act read with section 376 (DA) of the Indian Penal Code.
It has been alleged that the victim 'X' was subjected to rape by the appellant and the other accused persons.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that there was a previous dispute as would be evidence from the testimony of the mother of the victim PW-2 and the DNA does not indicate about the appellant having subjected the victim to rape.

Regard being had to the evidence of the victim it appears that the present appellant had initiated the commission of rape followed by the other accused persons and in view of the above, therefore, we are not inclined to admit the appellant on bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail is hereby rejected at this stage.
